title: Footer Share Buttons, Unified Profile+Wallet Page, and Restored Central Bank Page

requirements.text: Update the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx) to display only: the copyright line '© 2026 Quantumoney. Todos os direitos reservados.' and 'By HTgamers', plus four social share icon buttons for WhatsApp, X (Twitter), Telegram, and Instagram. Remove any and all references, links, or mentions of Caffeine from the footer. Do not change footer height, padding, or overall layout.

quotes: Mantém o rodapé como está atualmente: baixo, limpo
Adicionar apenas botões de partilha para: WhatsApp, X, Telegram e Instagram.
Remover completamente qualquer menção ou link Caffeine.
Não alterar altura ou layout do rodapé.

acceptanceCriteria: Footer shows exactly '© 2026 Quantumoney. Todos os direitos reservados.' and 'By HTgamers'
Four share buttons are present: WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Instagram
Each share button opens the respective platform share URL with the app's URL pre-filled
No Caffeine branding, links, or text appears anywhere in the footer
Footer height and layout are unchanged

requirements.text: Scan the entire frontend codebase and remove every occurrence of Caffeine branding, links, or references from all pages, components, and layout files — not just the footer.

quotes: Remover completamente qualquer menção ou link Caffeine.
Nenhum elemento de teste ou Caffeine deve aparecer no site.

acceptanceCriteria: No page, component, or layout file contains any visible Caffeine text, link, logo, or badge
No Caffeine-related href or external URL remains in the rendered HTML

requirements.text: Merge the Profile page (frontend/src/pages/Perfil.tsx or ProfilePage.tsx) and the Wallet page (frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx) into a single unified Profile page. The page must display: authenticated user info (principal, nickname, XP/level, energy), QMY and ICP balances, vesting breakdown, transaction history, and the simulated send card — all within one page. Use the existing glass panel style with yellow borders and yellow text. Do not create a separate wallet page or route; wallet content is embedded directly in the profile. Preserve existing authentication/registration guards.

quotes: Criar uma única página de Perfil que inclua: Informações do usuário. Carteira do usuário integrada diretamente na página de Perfil (não criar página separada para carteira).
Manter o restante layout, cores e elementos visuais do site como estão.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /profile (or equivalent route) shows user info and wallet content on the same page
QMY balance, ICP balance, vesting breakdown, transaction history, and simulated send card are all visible on the Profile page
No standalone wallet route (/wallet) exists or is linked in navigation
Yellow borders and yellow text styling are applied consistently
Unauthenticated users see a login prompt

requirements.text: Restore and complete the Central Bank page (frontend/src/pages/BancoCentral.tsx) so it publicly displays all of the following data synced from the Carteira A canisters: total QMY coin supply, circulating coins, locked/vesting coins, XP totals, bonus distributions, monster counts, and recent transactions. Use the existing canister IDs already configured in the project (from project_state.json / Carteira A). Data must be fetched via the same hooks and canister actors already used elsewhere in the app (e.g., useLuxuryBank, useQMYLedger). The page must be publicly visible without login. Maintain the existing yellow-on-dark glass panel visual style.

quotes: Restaurar a página Banco Central, garantindo que: Todas as moedas, monstros, XP, bônus, vesting e transações ficam visíveis ao público.
Informações totalmente sincronizadas com os canisters da Carteira A.
Não mexer no layout geral ou cores do site.

acceptanceCriteria: Central Bank page is accessible without authentication
Page displays: coin supply breakdown, circulating vs. locked tokens, vesting info, XP totals, bonus distributions, monster counts, and recent transactions
All data is fetched from the Carteira A canister IDs already configured in the project
Yellow text and yellow-bordered glass panels are used consistently
No layout or color changes are introduced to other pages

requirements.text: Ensure all Leaflet OpenStreetMap map pages (frontend/src/pages/MapPage.tsx and any AR map components) continue to display coin and monster marker positions in sync with the Carteira A canisters, using the same canister actor and hooks already in place. Do not alter map layout, styling, or configuration.

quotes: Usar os mesmos canisters da Carteira A que o site já está a usar.
Garantir que todos os mapas (Mapa Leaflet OpenStreetMap) e localização de moedas/monstros estão sincronizados com a aplicação QuantumoneyAR.app.

acceptanceCriteria: Map page renders coin and monster markers using data from the Carteira A canisters
No new canister IDs are introduced; existing configured IDs are used
Map layout, zoom, tile layer, and styling are unchanged

constraints: Do not alter header, map pages, AR/PWA pages, or any already-configured pages beyond what is specified
Do not create duplicate pages or routes
All yellow text and yellow borders must be preserved across modified components
Use only the existing Carteira A canister IDs already configured in the project — do not introduce new ones
Do not modify any file listed in frontend.immutablePaths
nonGoals: Adding any new pages beyond the unified Profile page
Changing navigation structure beyond removing the standalone wallet route
Modifying backend canister logic or data models
Altering colors, fonts, or global theme beyond enforcing existing yellow styling
Adding real-time WebSocket sync or push notifications
Any Caffeine-related UI or branding anywhere in the app
